_comment: Arbiter rulings from the F2 review (Taxonomy_Changelog §151 on). One entry per (paper, kind, slug): action endorse|reject, the ruling § and date. Applied to Zotero in batches as cal:human:<kind>:<slug> / cal:human:reject:<kind>:<slug>; 'written' records the batch.

rulings.author: Gao
rulings.note: route 1: observed review absence on the MERGED population (79.0% Human+AI, 86.8% non-owner); triage not shown, only hypothesised. Mechanism note: absence tracks AI visibility (AI-only 1.7%), not demonstrated capacity overload.

rulings.author: Branco
rulings.note: absence shown SELECTIVE by the paper's own data (smaller/focused PRs; less in mature projects; caution on deletions)

rulings.author: Ghammam
rulings.note: automated checks gated the merges; authors attribute light human review to trust

rulings.author: Watanabe
rulings.note: 'no revisions' is not review absence; no absence claim made

rulings.author: Liu
rulings.note: merged defects measured; no review signal measured on that population

rulings.author: Fu
rulings.note: §115: measures the effect of USING the analysers (detector → warning → LLM repair)

rulings.author: Karuppuchamy
rulings.note: SAST/SCA/licence scanners as a merge gate in the contributed system — use, not measurement

rulings.author: Ghammam
rulings.note: Sniffer measures the corpus; instrument, not contribution (§104)

rulings.author: Ferdous
rulings.note: detector yields breaking-change RATES (the world); 94-patch check validates the instrument (§104)

rulings.author: Ji
rulings.note: ESBMC is the study's oracle, not a contributed check (§104)

rulings.author: Ji
rulings.note: QA CORRECTION (§142a precedent): no built system — CSET report evaluating five third-party LLMs with off-the-shelf ESBMC + LLMSecEval prompts; 'not … create a new benchmark'

rulings.author: Abreu
rulings.note: release-risk predictor scored retrospectively on real history — results describe the tool

rulings.author: Watanabe
rulings.note: deletion predictor scored by cross-validation on real PRs (RQ2, tool-side)

rulings.author: Minh
rulings.note: arbiter-ruled built-system (Circuit Breaker classifier) scored on real AIDev PRs (AUC 0.958)

rulings.author: Mitropoulos
rulings.note: event 2: the authors' LLM-assisted iterative attack scored on 17 real CVEs / 10 real projects (pipelines rebuilt in isolation) — 100% success, 17/17

rulings.author: Mitropoulos
rulings.note: QA CORRECTION (§142a precedent): neither event is a benchmark run — CrossVul (event 1) is sampled for an experiment on third-party models; the 17 CVEs (event 2) are a selected real set
